## Mechanical-check evaluation (AC3): decision — do NOT add the lint

Proposed check: flag a test that imports the same fit/encode helper the module under test uses on both sides of an equality assertion.

Survey of the current tree (grep -rln 'fit_outbound|truncate_comment_body|fit_preserving_marker' tests/): **17 test files** import at least one of the shared fit helpers. The set includes tests whose sanctioned job is exactly the flagged shape:

- tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_dc_backend_characterization.py::test_dc_fit_comment_is_the_send_path_fit — deliberately pins fit_comment byte-identical to the send-path fit by calling both helpers on both sides of an equality.
- tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_dc_comment_ceiling_049e.py::test_fit_comment_converges_with_sanitize_comment — same sanctioned shape.
- Direct unit tests of the helpers themselves (comment_limits / AdfCodec.fit_outbound), which necessarily call the helper on both the arrange and assert side.

The defective shape and the sanctioned shape are syntactically identical: both are 'equality assertion where each side is derived via a shared fit helper'. What distinguishes them is INTENT — whether one side *represents an external effect* (a landed Jira body) rather than the helper's own contract. That property is not recoverable from imports or AST structure, so any implementable version of the check either (a) flags the ~17 legitimate files (unacceptable false-positive cost, and the noise trains authors to suppress it) or (b) is narrowed until it cannot catch the next instance (the two historical instances used *different* compositions — truncate_comment_body vs fit_preserving_marker(...) — so a pattern-list check goes stale exactly like the tests it polices).

Decision: record the rule as authoring guidance instead — landed in examples/agent-skills/shared/test-design.md §4 ('Convergence tests: capture the external-effect side, never re-derive it', with both instances as the worked example), synced byte-identically to the rebar-debug/rebar-implement/rebar-brainstorm copies (gated by tests/unit/test_skill_shared_sync.py).
